## Mapping Decisions

- Use one master record per source record, keyed by `RECORD_ID`; the nested `RECORD_TYPE` distinguishes PERSON and ORGANIZATION.
- Preserve the selected address rule: use structured parts when present in the same source feature object; otherwise use `ADDR_FULL`.
- Emit phone type only with a phone number. Keep identifier qualifiers with their identifier numbers.
- Preserve root `AMOUNT`, `CATEGORY`, `DATE`, and `STATUS` as payload.
- Source feature values are copied without normalization.
